newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol says investment to be self-financed.
newsitem.headline: Repsol says investment to be self-financed.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol plans to self-finance forecast investments of 1.6 billion pesetas until 2001, chairman Alfonso Cortina said on Thursday.
The firm said it has no plans to issue convertible bonds, although it will have the possibility of alternative financing if needs be.

"Repsol has self-financing capacity and with the proposals that will be put to shareholders (on Friday) it will also have the flexibility of calling on the capital market if it believes it is necessary," Cortina said.
The energy group announced its investment plans in April, ahead of its full privatisation.
On the agenda for Friday's shareholders' meeting is an item to authorise the issue of convertible bonds over a period of five years.
This item prompted market comment on whether the energy firm may be planning to issue convertibles.
